\section{Introduction}
% TL;DR: The routing mechanism in sparse expert models is fragile.
Recently, mixture-of-experts models have attracted considerable attention. In our prior work, we demonstrated that routers collapse. The model knows which expert to use. Jane Doe first noticed this \cite{shazeer2017}.

Experts can be routed via a learned gating mechanism, which can be very helpful. We investigate this critical area in depth.
